What is the exact definition and formula of peak region on the Peak Region Definition knowledge page
peak region is the region with the highest total order count across all orders
peak region is the region generating the highest number of orders regardless of revenue
region with most customers peak region

args.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM memory.bench.customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY customer_count DESC

transcript.text:
The insight and the direct query both confirm the "peak region" definition: the region with the most customers.

The customers table (memory.bench.customers) shows region counts: West=24, East=20, South=19, North=17. West has the highest customer count.

FINAL ANSWER: West
